sections.label: Police Camera 2.0 project
sections.summary: As of 2017, about 5,000 PolCam 2.0 cameras were installed in town centres, neighbourhood centres, hawker centres and linkways, helping solve over 2,300 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As of 2017, the Police have installed about 5,000 cameras under the Police Camera (PolCam) 2.0 project, in town centres, neighbourhood centres, hawker centres and linkways leading to transportation nodes, such as the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations and bus interchanges.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: PolCam 2.0 includes cameras which are designed to detect some anomalous events.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These include public order situations like persons fighting and sudden congregation or dispersal of crowd.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The system can also identify suspects and allow officers to quickly search for images to facilitate investigations.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As at the end of 2017, video footage from Polcams have helped the Police solve more than 2,300 cases.

sections.label: 2016 Police perception survey
sections.summary: A 2016 Police survey found about 95% of respondents feel safe in their neighbourhoods and trust the Singapore Police Force.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In a perception survey conducted in 2016 by the Police, about 95% of respondents feel safe in their neighbourhoods and trust the Singapore Police Force (SPF) as an organisation.

sections.label: PolCam 2.0 installation plans
sections.summary: The Police plan to install 11,000 cameras at 2,500 locations island-wide under PolCam 2.0 over the next few years, with about 6,000 more to go.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: The Police plan to install 11,000 cameras at 2,500 locations island-wide under the PolCam 2.0 programme and this will be done over the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: As I have mentioned just now, we have installed about 5,000 cameras.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: So, we have about 6,000 more to go, under PolCam 2.0.
